notes.title: Update Notes – July 31, 2025
notes.notes:
New Update Available!
In this update, we’ve made a few small adjustments to help new players progress through the first half of the game more smoothly:

 New Items in the Shop

The Helmet and Cloak have been added to the shop.
This is to help new players discover that armor exists and that they can use Actives, Precision, and Health Regeneration.

 Adjusted Item Requirements

The number of items needed to level up the first tiers has been reduced.
This makes it easier to get into the game mechanics and progress early on.
 Higher tiers remain unchanged.

notes.title: 🚀 Ferral Quest launches on April 4th! ⚔️🌍
notes.notes:
🗓 Official launch of Ferral Quest on April 4th 🗓

The big day is coming! Ferral Quest, the pixel-art MMORPG, is launching on Steam. Get ready to explore an open world filled with unique biomes, challenging dungeons, and epic bosses.

🔥 What awaits you in Ferral Quest? 🔥
✅ Open-world PvE and dungeons with wandering bosses
✅ Progression from Tier 0 to Tier 10
✅ Skill tree and character customization
✅ Clans, competitive PvP, and leaderboards
✅ A deep story: uncover who you were before rising as a skeleton
✅ Exclusive Steam Bonus: +3 attribute points at the start!

🛡 Do you have what it takes to defeat the necromancer Ferral and break your curse? Get ready for battle!

💾 Add it to your wishlist and join the community before launch!
